ओह माय गॉड! क्या सच में रामायण का हर फ्रेम है इतना धांसू? 🔥

कल यानी स्क्रीन पर रिलीज़ होने वाली सबसे बड़े बजट की फिल्म Ramayana का मुंबई में मंगलवार को स्पेशल स्क्रीनिंग हुआ!
सिंगर और म्यूज़िक कंपोज़र Badshah ने फिल्म देखने के बाद X पर जमकर तारीफ की और कहा कि यह फिल्म देखकर उनकी आँखें नम हो गईं। 😢
Badshah का कहना है कि फिल्म का Jatayu scene बेहद शानदार है और BGM एकदम कमाल का है!
Nitesh Tiwari के निर्देशन में बनी इस फिल्म का बजट रिपोर्ट के मुताबिक 4000 करोड़ रुपये है और यह दुनिया की सबसे महंगी फिल्मों में से एक है। 💰
फिल्म में Ranbir Kapoor राम के रोल में, Sai Pallavi सीता के रोल में और Yash रावण के रोल में नज़र आएंगे। 🎬
इस फिल्म के मेकर्स ने Sony Pictures के साथ पार्टनरशिप की है जिसके तहत यह 70,000 स्क्रीन्स पर रिलीज़ होगी।
पहला पार्ट 5 नवंबर 2026 को रिलीज़ होगा और दूसरा पार्ट Diwali 2027 में आएगा!
तो क्या आप सिनेमाघरों में यह ग्रैंड विजुअल देखने के लिए तैयार हैं? नीचे कमेंट्स में बताओ! 👇✨

ctx.title: Badshah hails Jatayu scene in Ramayana in his review, says every frame in Ranbir Kapoor and Sai Pallavi-starrer is breathtaking: ‘Made me cry’
ctx.summary: Ramayana stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, and Yash as Ravana. The film is directed by Nitesh Tiwari.
ctx.text:
All eyes are on Ramayana as it releases in screens tomorrow. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, Ramayana is the biggest Indian film in terms of scale and budget. After its world premiere in Los Angeles last week, Ramayana held a special screening in Mumbai on Tuesday, attended by the cast and crew, as well as members of the film fraternity.
Singer and music composer Badshah has seen the film and posted a review of the film just before its release day. Responding to a post on X where a user said that they are excited to see the film after looking at the rave reviews it is getting, Badshah wrote in the caption, “You have to watch it. Namit has delivered. Every frame is breathtaking. The characters feel so real. It made me cry, even when we’ve known the story since our childhood. INCREDIBL BGM. Ranbir, Sai Pallavi, Ravi Dubey, Yash, Lara Dutta, Arun Govil, Rakul. Everyone nailed it. Jatayu scene is insane. And wait for the moment when the dharti amber theme comes. CLAPSSSS. PLEASE GO WATCH IT.”
Ramayana, made on a reported budget of ₹ 4000 crore, is one of the most expensive film productions in the world, not just in India. With VFX from eight-time Oscar-winning studio DNEG, it is being marketed as India's first film equivalent of Hollywood blockbusters. For its global release, the makers have partnered with Sony Pictures, which is giving it the widest release for any Indian film - in 70,000 screens.
Directed by Nitesh Tiwari and produced by Namit's Prime Focus and Yash's Monster Mind Creations, Ramayana stars Ranbir Kapoor as Lord Rama, Sai Pallavi as Sita, and Yash as Ravana. The first part is scheduled for worldwide release on November 5, 2026, while the second part is set for Diwali 2027. The films will release in Hindi, Tamil, Telugu, Kannada and Malayalam across India.
"In India, there are a lot of questions like, 'Why are they making the Ramayana when there have been so many Ramayanas? We already know the story.' And I'm like, 'Listen, we're making it because we want to show you the version of this story that you've never seen.' No television show, no street play, no Ram Leela has ever shown you the Ramayana on this scale and with this spectacle that we are making...Much like an Avatar or an Avengers movie or think about Spider-Man or The Odyssey. We're putting Ramayana right up there next to all of those spectacles," Namit Malhotra told PTI.
Santanu Das is a Senior Content Producer at Hindustan Times with over 5 years of experience, writing on films, pop culture and film festivals. He has a keen interest in writing about South Asian independent films and has covered several film festivals, including Sundance and CPH: Docx. His favourite books include The Corrections, The God of Small Things and A Room of One's Own.
